fusions.name: Pronking Stamp
fusions.desc: Springs up and lands, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rutting Clash
fusions.desc: Clashes horns with the target, dealing 34 damage plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Twig-Snap Bolt
fusions.desc: Springs you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 30% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Ever-Watchful Footing
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
